intro.line: An Omenpath opens over a city of glass towers and webs. Then, past it, another opens onto four nations at war.
Neither world is part of the Multiverse you know. Each has its own heroes, its own villains and its own rules.
Recorded: crossings sit outside Magic canon. You are only passing through, twice.

finale.line: The Phoenix King falls, and the comet that was meant to burn the world fades from the sky.
I will never, ever turn my back on people who need me!
The Omenpaths fold shut, one after the other. The road turns back to the Multiverse.

villainFinale.line: In this version the war never ends. The skies stay red.
Out of the ashes, a new world will be born.
The last Omenpath flickers, and holds just long enough for you to leave.

battles.title: Web-Slinging
battles.blurb: A photographer on a rooftop, a gang at the corner and a camera that needs film.

scene.line: This batch of web fluid will just have to wait!
Web-slinging: cast it for its web cost by returning a tapped creature to your hand. A swing, a reset and a ready ambush.

villainScene.line: Don't be a hero, Gary! We don't get paid enough for a scrap with Spider-Man!
The Wild Pack: one corner, three crooks and nobody wants to be first.

hero.half: Web-sling a tapped creature to recast it cheaply.

battles.title: Mayhem
battles.blurb: A punk spider with a guitar, a symbiote that learned the wrong lesson and a rooftop concert.

scene.line: Disrespect authority. Smash the system.
Mayhem: if a card was discarded this turn, you may cast it from your graveyard right away. Use it before the turn ends.

villainScene.line: We like seeing fear in our victim's eyes.
Sinner takes all. The symbiote does not need a reason.

hero.half: Discard, then cast it from the graveyard.

battles.title: Doctor Octopus
battles.blurb: Four arms, one plan and a lab full of henchmen who want out.

scene.line: Charismatic and confident, Mary Jane was born for the limelight.
Tokens are creatures without a card behind them. Make a crowd and ride it to the finish.

villainScene.line: Soon all will cower before the superior intellect of Doctor Octopus!
The Master Planner has a plan. The henchmen have a union.

battles.title: The Green Goblin
battles.blurb: A glider, a pumpkin bomb and a laugh that carries across the rooftops.

scene.line: Spiders across the Multiverse are dying. I must keep them safe.
Combat math: count the blocks and the trick before you commit. A pumpkin bomb ends a bad attack.

villainScene.line: Oscorp has a glider, a bomb and a very long grudge.

battles.title: The Four Nations
battles.blurb: The last Airbender wakes in a world where the Fire Nation has been waiting a hundred years.

scene.line: When the world needed him most, the Avatar returned.
Bending: each nation has its own element and its own trick. Airbending sends a creature away to be cast again for two.

villainScene.line: We are the sons and daughters of fire, the superior element!
The raiders are young, fast and very sure of themselves.

battles.title: Earthbending
battles.blurb: The King of Omashu has a puzzle for you, and the Dai Li have a different plan.

scene.line: You thought I was a frail old man, but I'm the most powerful Earthbender you'll ever see.
Earthbend: a land becomes a creature with counters, and it comes back if it dies. Rock is a stubborn element.

villainScene.line: In silencing talk of conflict, Ba Sing Se remains a peaceful, orderly utopia.
The Dai Li do not fight in the open. They arrange things.

hero.half: Earthbend a land into a fighter.

battles.title: Koh, the Face Stealer
battles.blurb: Show no emotion in the spirit swamp. Koh takes faces, and koh is patient.

scene.line: You can't knock me down!
Just push and pull the water—like this.
Locking creatures down: tap them, stun them, or take their attack away. Koh will lock you the same way.

villainScene.line: I take faces. I do not hurry.
The swamp is old. The swamp remembers every face it has taken.

hero.half: Lock his big creature before it attacks.

battles.title: The Phoenix King
battles.blurb: Sozin's Comet burns overhead. The Fire Lord has promised to end the war by ending the world.

scene.line: I'm okay. Just finish the mission!
When the world needed him most, the Avatar returned.
Direct damage skips combat. Use it to finish him when the board is stuck.

villainScene.line: Out of the ashes, a new world will be born.
You will learn respect, and suffering will be your teacher.

hero.half: Burn him out when the board is stuck.

battles.title: The Spider-Totems
battles.blurb: A hunter has been tracking every spider in the Multiverse. This one is the last on his list.

archive.what: A green deck of hunters and big creatures from the set: Spider-Rex, Lizard, Kraven's Cats.
archive.why: It stands for the hunt that follows every Spider, not a list anyone won with.
archive.beat: Block the big ones, chump the pack and burn out the totem.
archive.after: Nothing; this is the optional superboss at the end of the story.

deck.name: The Spider-Totems
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No tournament list is copied.

scene.line: I'm creating an all-new legacy.
The hunter seeks only the greatest prey.

villainScene.line: I have found honor, not in the civilized, but in the primal.

after.line: Recorded: the last spider escapes the hunt. The Omenpaths close.

hero.half: Chump the big ones, burn the pack.
